lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense, stochastic distribution of high-luminance circular clusters is present in the anterior region, which transitions into highly ordered vertical columns of blobs in the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a distinct rectilinear grid pattern visible across the mid and posterior sections of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run across the upper third of the visible flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient featuring high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, depigmented yellowish-tan patch is located on the upper mid-flank. Multiple smaller, pale, linear marks are also visible in the region posterior to the branchial slits.
